quotes.text: When you try to automate a thing, you realize how smart people are. Even the guy that you don't think is that bright is adding a ton of value in the process.

What history shows is the lock-in risk isn't ever actually at the infrastructure layer. It's when you're closer to the customer. So I would be more worried about a Palantir, and I'd be more worried about a Microsoft.
Knowing how to run a construction company is infinitely more complex than what they need to know about AI. This is just another tool.
